answer: Anyone running 164 aliases as a result needs 146 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in anchor, expire in spiral, and ledge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3957 identities would post 1164 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
